run_vsd_worker: run a VSD pose error worker with --worker_id and --input_dir CLI arguments
create_renderer_from_config: create a renderer from renderer_args.json with width, height, render_type, mode, shading, and bg_color
add_object_to_renderer: add a 3D object to the renderer using an object ID and model path from models_dict.json
compute_vsd_pose_error: compute the visual subpixel distance pose error using pose_error.vsd with estimated and ground truth poses
save_vsd_results: save VSD pose error results to a JSON file named worker_{worker_id}.json in the input directory
